ch18.d.proc: How the state of the gas changes
ch18.d.dirV: Double the volume or halve it
ch18.d.dirT: Double or halve the pressure at fixed volume
ch18.goal.first: First law of thermodynamics: $\Delta E_\text{int} = Q - W$ ($Q$: heat into the gas, $W$: work done by the gas)
ch18.goal.area: Work done by the gas $W$ = area under the $p$-$V$ curve, negative when the volume shrinks (hatched)
ch18.obs.isobaric: Isobaric expansion: only part of the heat becomes work, the rest raises the internal energy; $Q = \tfrac{f+2}{2}\,p\Delta V$
ch18.obs.isochoric: Isochoric: piston locked, $W = 0$, so all the heat goes into internal energy; $Q = \Delta E_\text{int}$
ch18.obs.isothermal: Isothermal: constant temperature, so $\Delta E_\text{int} = 0$ and all the heat becomes work; $Q = W$
ch18.obs.adiabatic: Adiabatic: $Q = 0$, so the work done in expanding comes out of the internal energy and the gas cools. The curve is steeper than an isotherm
ch18.obs.gas: Diatomic gas: larger $\Delta E_\text{int}$ for the same temperature change, less steep adiabat ($\gamma = 7/5$)
ch18.assume.ideal: Ideal gas, about 0.401 mol (300 K at 10 L and 100 kPa)
ch18.assume.quasi: Quasi-static processes: equilibrium at every instant. Frictionless piston. Dots in the cylinder sketch molecular motion (fewer and slower than real)
ch18.d.hl: Path whose area under the curve (work done by the gas) is shaded
ch18.d.B: State where all three paths end
ch18.p2.goal.path: Work and heat depend on the path
ch18.p2.goal.state: The change in internal energy depends only on the initial and final states (state function)
ch18.p2.obs.W: $W$ = area under the curve: largest on the upper path ACB, smallest on the lower path ADB
ch18.p2.obs.E: All three paths give the same $\Delta E_\text{int}$
ch18.p2.obs.Q: $Q = \Delta E_\text{int} + W$: the path with more work also takes in more heat
ch18.p2.obs.b2: B = 20 L, 50 kPa: same temperature as A, so $\Delta E_\text{int} = 0$ and $Q = W$ on every path
ch18.p2.obs.b3: B = 30 L, 20 kPa: the gas cools, $\Delta E_\text{int} < 0$, and path ADB gives off heat ($Q < 0$)
ch18.d.cyc: Rectangle: four isochoric and isobaric steps; Carnot: four isothermal and adiabatic steps
ch18.d.dir: Direction around the loop in the $p$-$V$ diagram
ch18.c.goal.cycle: Cyclic process: the gas returns to its initial state, so $\Delta E_\text{int} = 0$ and $Q_\text{net} = W_\text{net}$
ch18.c.goal.area: Net work per cycle = area enclosed by the loop
ch18.c.obs.zero: After one full cycle: the $\Delta E_\text{int}$ bar is zero and the $Q$ and $W$ bars are equal
ch18.c.obs.area: Area under the expansion steps (shaded) minus area under the compression steps (hatched) = enclosed area
ch18.c.obs.ccw: Counter-clockwise: $W_\text{net} < 0$; the surroundings do work on the gas and the gas gives off that much heat (refrigerator)
ch18.c.obs.carnot: Carnot cycle: heat in from the 600 K reservoir, heat out to the 300 K reservoir, no heat on the adiabatic steps
